task: predict delta (978 landmarks) for a (cell, drug_group) unit whose drug's RNA response is not in training (any cell)

inputs_at_prediction.x0: the unit's plate DMSO control profile (978, measured), standardised with training statistics
inputs_at_prediction.ecfp4: 2048-bit Morgan r2 fingerprint of the group's representative pert_id
inputs_at_prediction.cell_mean_anchor: m_c = mean training-drug delta of the same cell (training units only)
inputs_at_prediction.drug_target_seeds: ChEMBL 37 evidence for the drug's structure-linked family (mech / binding / functional; action sign or unknown; mapping flags); empty if unannotated
inputs_at_prediction.graph: OmniPath (omnipath + collectri) directed relations among targets, intermediates and landmarks; fixed for all drugs
inputs_at_prediction.xpert_only: UniMol atom features, released XPert HG drug embedding (zero if unlinked), XPert PPI gene vectors

never_inputs: treated RNA of the unit or of the same drug in any cell
response-derived similarity of the query drug
test / validation deltas in any statistic, teacher, graph or node selection
information_cost: external annotation of the query drug is allowed (public database lookup); no additional RNA measurement

checks.xpert_treated_slot: manifests/evidence_gated_r7/runs/xpert_*_pred_*.json (max abs diff when the treated slot changes)
